extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data issues affecting the average body mass by species. (1) Removed 5 duplicate rows. (2) Normalized 9 misspelled or malformed species labels (e.g. 'Chintsrap' -> 'Chinstrap'). (3) Normalized 17 misspelled or malformed sex labels (e.g. 'malle' -> 'male'). (4) Converted 22 body mass values from text (e.g. '3,500.0') to numbers. (5) Excluded 15 rows where body mass was outside the valid range [2500, 6500] grams (likely data entry errors with extra zeros). After these fixes, calculated the average body mass: Adelie: 3666.12 g, Chinstrap: 3748.89 g, Gentoo: 5155.84 g.
